name: Urban Enviro Waste Management Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Urban Enviro Waste Management Limited provides Waste Management Solutions & Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) Management services.[1]
keyPoints:
Latest Order Update
From 1 October 2024 to 4 March 2025, Company has received Total Confirmed Orders worth Rs 95.16 Crore leading to Additional Annual Revenue of Rs 85.74 Crore. Company's contracts are usually recurring in nature leading to extension of contracts. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 68.7% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 43.2%
